verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed professional-services law firm offering fintech, venture, IP, privacy and employment counsel, not a software product, platform or API. Asking whether it ships an official MCP server for agent connectivity is a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any software interface: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
